services.name: cloudflare
allowed_interfaces: cloudflare-api dns create/update/delete within the bound zone only
services.credential_policy: User-owned scoped API token (account tokens lack Registrar support); lives only in .env.local or process env; never printed, committed, or echoed into logs.
hard_constraints: Never register/purchase/transfer domains via the API - purchases are dashboard-only and non-refundable.
DNS mutations only within the zone bound via CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_NAME/CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID.
Never print the token or raw response bodies.
Registrar setting changes (auto_renew/locked/privacy) require explicit approval.
services.rollback_or_disable_command: Roll or delete the API token in the Cloudflare dashboard (My Profile -> API Tokens), remove CLOUDFLARE_* from .env.local, delete scripts/cloudflare-api.mjs.
